3.6v.bmad-dev-story:
WAVE 4B DEV CONTEXT (binding, learned in Wave 4A):
1. SURVIVABILITY: commit after EVERY completed task or sub-task (small commits, prefix 'dev(3.6v):') and tick the story checkboxes as you go, so an interruption loses little. Keep every command under ~5 minutes; redirect long output to /tmp/3.6v/ files and only tail the summary.
2. The Pre-Coding Approval Gate is NOT pre-approved: put it to the user via AskUserQuestion as usual.
3. Scoped checks only: pnpm --filter <pkg> test/lint, and tsc --noEmit via a self-cleaning temp tsconfig inside the package that extends ./tsconfig.json with compilerOptions.ignoreDeprecations '6.0' (the sandbox TypeScript needs it). NEVER a bare 'pnpm test', whole-repo 'pnpm build/lint/test' or 'turbo' - the orchestrator runs those once at batch end. Leave the story's root-level build/lint/test bullets unchecked with a note 'deferred to the orchestrator batch-end gate'.
4. NEVER git stash and never overwrite working files with HEAD copies. For a baseline use 'git show <rev>:<path> > /tmp/...' or a throwaway 'git worktree add /tmp/<name> <rev>' removed afterwards. If a temporary debug script must live inside the repo to resolve imports, delete it before committing.
5. Backend tests: run with 'TZ=UTC npx cross-env NODE_ENV=test tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 <file>' (a single file or --test-name-pattern at a time); the DB is shared, so never run backend tests in parallel with anything else. The sandbox database may be empty ('Should have at least 2 users' means run 'pnpm --filter @festgrid/database seed' first). Known, unrelated failures to IGNORE and not 'fix': 22 backend tests (17 geolocation/location tests needing GEOAPIFY_API_KEY, the Bright Data CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED test, and their parents) and 1 infrastructure test ('FestgridBackendStack provisions correct resources', a 12 vs '12' type assertion). Report only NEW failures.
6. If an EXPLAIN gate needs volume data: check disk has >15 GB free first, and ALWAYS run 'pnpm --filter @festgrid/database seed:volume:clean' afterwards, even on failure.
7. Known pre-existing ~99 tsc errors in packages/ui test files (EventDetailView.test.tsx, EventDiscoveryPanel.test.tsx, FilterHub.test.tsx, combineDateTime.test.ts, useCurrentLocationCapture.test.ts, core/map.tsx) - report only NEW ones.
8. When all tasks are done: complete the Dev Agent Record, set sprint status to review via scripts/sprint-status-tool.py (get first, then set ... review --expect in-progress), commit.
